_comment: PLACEHOLDER — adjust all values to match your actual vault's frontmatter conventions.
The keys listed under 'frontmatterMap' are the YAML frontmatter field names that the
Synapse Generator will look for in each .md file. If your vault uses different names
(e.g. 'type' instead of 'category', or 'date_modified' instead of 'modified') update
the values here. The keys themselves (categoryKey, levelKey, …) must not be changed —
they are the generator's internal identifiers.
Deploy this file to /opt/synapse/generator.config.json on the Raspberry Pi.
The post-receive hook reads it via the SYNAPSE_CONFIG env var.
